title: 20% Off at Selected Restaurants
description: Enjoy 20% savings when you dine at selected partner restaurants islandwide using your ComBank Visa or Mastercard credit card.
terms: Valid for dine-in only at participating restaurants.
Maximum discount of Rs. 2,000 per transaction.
Cannot be combined with other offers.
Subject to merchant and bank terms and conditions.

title: 10% Cashback at Keells Super
description: Get 10% cashback on grocery purchases at all Keells Super outlets when you pay with any Sampath Bank card.
terms: Maximum cashback of Rs. 500 per transaction.
Valid for a minimum spend of Rs. 3,000.
Limited to two transactions per card per month.

title: 15% Off at Cinnamon Hotels & Resorts
description: Book your stay at any Cinnamon Hotels & Resorts property in Sri Lanka and save 15% when paying with your HNB Visa Credit Card.
terms: Not valid on public holidays and special events.
Advance booking of at least 7 days required.

title: 5% Cashback on All Fuel Purchases
description: Earn 5% cashback on every fuel purchase at CPC and Lanka IOC outlets when you use your BOC Mastercard Credit Card.
terms: Maximum cashback of Rs. 250 per fill.
Valid at all CPC and Lanka IOC outlets.

title: 12% Off on Abans Electronics
description: Get 12% off on selected electronics, home appliances, and gadgets at Abans showrooms with your Sampath Mastercard Credit Card.
terms: Not valid on already discounted items.
Valid at all Abans showrooms islandwide.

title: Buy 1 Get 1 Free – Buffet Dining
description: Enjoy a Buy 1 Get 1 complimentary buffet offer at participating hotel restaurants with your HNB Visa or Debit Card.
terms: Complimentary cover of equal or lesser value.

title: 10% Off Online Shopping – All Visa Cards
description: Shop online at participating e-commerce stores and enjoy 10% off your purchase when you pay with any Sri Lankan bank Visa credit or debit card.
terms: Discount applied at checkout using promo code.

title: 0% Installments for 12 Months at Singer
description: Purchase any Singer home appliance or electronics and enjoy 0% interest installments for up to 12 months with your BOC Mastercard Credit Card.

title: 15% Off at Paradise Road Stores
description: Treat yourself to a 15% discount on all purchases at Paradise Road stores with your People's Bank Visa Credit Card.
terms: Valid at all Paradise Road outlets.
Maximum discount of Rs. 3,000 per transaction.

title: 20% Off at Odel – All Visa Credit Cards
description: Shop fashion, homeware and more at Odel and receive 20% off your total bill when paying with any Visa credit card from participating banks.
terms: Not valid during promotional sale periods.

title: 5% Cashback at Cargills Food City
description: Enjoy 5% cashback every time you shop at Cargills Food City supermarkets with any Commercial Bank credit or debit card.
terms: Cashback credited to card account within 45 days.
Maximum cashback of Rs. 750 per transaction.
Valid for a minimum spend of Rs. 2,500.
Valid at all Cargills Food City outlets.

title: Free Room Upgrade at Selected Resorts
description: Get a complimentary room upgrade when booking directly with your HNB Visa Credit Card at selected premium resort properties.
terms: Subject to availability at the time of booking.
Valid for a minimum stay of 2 nights.

title: 15% Off Dining at Rare – Sampath Mastercard
description: Dine at Rare Restaurant, Colombo, and enjoy 15% off your food bill with your Sampath Bank Mastercard Credit Card.

title: 10% Off at Softlogic – ComBank Mastercard
description: Shop electronics and appliances at Softlogic Life and save 10% with your Commercial Bank Mastercard Credit Card.
terms: Cannot be combined with any other promotion.

title: Special Discounts at Laugfs Supermarket
description: All bank cardholders enjoy special member discounts at Laugfs Supermarket outlets with any credit or debit card.
terms: Valid at all Laugfs Supermarket outlets.
Cannot be combined with other promotions.
